title: Payzzy
tagline: Payzzy is a hassle-free cross-chain pay-easy solution

prizes.placement: 🥉 Li.Fi — Best use of LI.FI SDK or API
prizes.title: LI.FI

description: You can now use the blockchain's full potential at the same pace as conventional payment networks without worrying about various chains and tokens. In simple, you can now make payments from any chain to any chain & with your preferred token using Payzzy.
how_its_made:
- Testnet for Li.fi was not working, reached out to the team for the fix and they added test tokens.
- Cross-chain transaction status tracking was a challenge then we used Covalent API to fix it.
